def padd33 : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, m => m
  | n+1, m => padd33 n m + 1

theorem padd33_zero_right (n : Nat) : padd33 n 0 = n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp [padd33, ih]

theorem padd33_succ_right (n m : Nat) : padd33 n (m+1) = padd33 n m + 1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp [padd33, ih]
theorem padd33_comm (n m : Nat) : padd33 n m = padd33 m n :=
A: by
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => simp [padd33, padd33_zero_right]
  | succ k ih => simp [padd33, ih, padd33_succ_right]

  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp [padd4491, ih]

  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp [padd4491, ih]
theorem padd4491_comm (n m : Nat) : padd4491 n m = padd4491 m n :=

  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => simp [padd4491, padd4491_zero_right]
